content: Advance M0130/W0132 with a private Vulkan 1.3 instance/device/compute-queue context bound to the existing capability profile. Enable only queried timeline semaphore, Synchronization2, and buffer-device-address features; submit empty timeline signals and expose deterministic generation/timeout/device-loss status without crossing the C ABI or claiming allocation, external-memory, dual-driver, or 1.0 qualification.

The device context selects an exact profile-matching physical device by vendor/device and non-zero UUID, requires a compute queue and the baseline Vulkan 1.3 feature chain, and owns all Vulkan handles privately. Unavailable loader/ICD or no compatible device returns no_device so lean shells can skip; a host runtime smoke uses .#vulkan-runtime and remains AMD/RADV provisioning evidence only. Timeline submissions require a strictly increasing generation-bound value and completion is observed through vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue/vkWaitSemaphores.

Content revision 8afbe2a adds the private VulkanDeviceContext and physical smoke test. It rechecks profile identity/properties/limits/memory totals, enables Vulkan 1.3 compute plus timeline semaphore, Synchronization2, and buffer-device-address, and exercises generation-checked empty vkQueueSubmit2 timeline signals, waits, polls, reset, and invalid paths. Lean Vulkan CTest passed 89/89; explicit .#vulkan-runtime RADV CTest passed 1/1 with queue-family=0 and timeline=2.
